visualCharacteristics: Borderless key/value 'spec sheet'. Each row is a label/value pair: uppercase muted label above a bold value, with a light grey left accent border. No header row by default.
contentPattern: One row per spec: cell 1 = label (e.g. 'Activity'), cell 2 = value (e.g. 'Rock Climbing').
usage: Adventure detail page — metadata sidebar (Activity, Adventure Type, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price).
